chunks: Yūnus narrated from Abū Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: How did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله strike lashes?

He said: "He used to strike with sandals, and he would increase it each time the drinker was brought. Then the people continued increasing it until that settled at eighty. ʿAlī عليه السلام indicated that to ʿUmar, and he approved of it."

key_terms.بِالشَّارِبِ: the one who drank the intoxicant
key_terms.بِالنِّعَالِ: with sandals, as the instrument of striking
key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ: eighty, the settled number of lashes mentioned here
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam ʿAlī, peace be upon him

ai.seo_question: How did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله punish drinking intoxicants, and how was the number of lashes set at eighty?
ai.summary: This hadith describes how the punishment for drinking intoxicants was carried out in the time of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and how its number later came to be set at eighty. It also records that ʿAlī عليه السلام advised ʿUmar regarding this measure, and he accepted it.
